description_short: One window showing all your world map mines: storage fill level, remaining reserves and status at a glance, with a pause button for each mine.
description_long:
Tired of clicking through every world map mine to see which one is full or running dry?

Outpost Overview adds a window (toolbar button or F8) that lists all your repaired world map mines in one place.

Features:
- One compact line per mine: product icon, name, storage fill level, remaining reserve, estimated years left and status
- Sort by storage, reserve, years left or name with a click on the column header, or drag the mines into your own order
- Pause or resume a mine directly from the overview
- Automatic pause / resume: set limits with storage-style sliders and the mine pauses when its storage is full enough and resumes when it has been emptied
- The toolbar button appears once you own a world mine; F8 always works
- Sorting and your own order are remembered per game
- Works on existing saves, install and go

Safe to remove: the mod only reads the game's own data and writes nothing into your save (window settings are kept in a small file in the mod folder).
